title: Layout of containments on "Manage Desktops and Panels" window should match actual Display Configuration
line: Manage Panels and Desktops now shows screens where they really are: side by side, stacked, or in a grid, with disconnected screens underneath.
explanation: The window put screens in a wrapping Flow in screen pool order (primary first), so a screen on the left or one stacked below could show up anywhere, and vertical arrangements could not be represented at all. The model now gives each connected screen a row and column from its geometry: it goes one column after every screen entirely to its left and one row below every screen entirely above it, with overlapping (cloned) screens bumped to the next free cell; disconnected screens fill rows below. The QML lays the cards out with a centered GridLayout at those cells (not mirrored for RTL, since it is physical), and the model reloads when a screen's geometry changes.

commits.message:
shell: give screens a grid position that follows their arrangement

The Manage Panels and Desktops model listed screens in screen pool
order, so the window couldn't show them the way they're arranged. Each
screen now gets a row and column from its geometry, disconnected below.

BUG: 477122

desktoppackage: place screens like their real arrangement

Manage Panels and Desktops showed screens in a flowing list unrelated to
where they are, so a screen on the left could appear last. Screens are
now placed on a grid at the row and column given by the model.

BUG: 477122

patches.diff:
From 22efc35375ba6cd5d8689fc5d03865b2b90ae7ca Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 21:42:51 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] desktoppackage: place screens like their real arrangement

Manage Panels and Desktops showed screens in a flowing list unrelated to
where they are, so a screen on the left could appear last. Screens are
now placed on a grid at the row and column given by the model.

BUG: 477122
---
 .../ShellContainmentConfiguration.qml         | 33 ++++++++++++++-----
 .../Delegate.qml                              |  2 --
 2 files changed, 24 insertions(+), 11 deletions(-)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/ShellContainmentConfiguration.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/ShellContainmentConfiguration.qml
index 6b468a93f5..f20d29c419 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/ShellContainmentConfiguration.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/ShellContainmentConfiguration.qml
@@ -67,17 +67,32 @@ Kirigami.AbstractApplicationWindow {
         rightPadding: 0
         bottomPadding: 0
 
-        Flow {
-            id: mainGrid
-            width: mainPage.flickable.width
-            spacing: 0
+        Item {
+            implicitWidth: mainGrid.implicitWidth
+            implicitHeight: mainGrid.implicitHeight
 
-            Repeater {
-                id: repeater
-                model: ShellContainmentModel
+            GridLayout {
+                id: mainGrid
+                readonly property int cellWidth: Math.min(Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 25, Math.floor(mainPage.flickable.width / ShellContainmentModel.layoutColumns))
 
-                delegate: Delegate {
-                    viewPort: mainPage
+                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
+                rowSpacing: 0
+                columnSpacing: 0
+                // Screens are placed like they are physically arranged, also for right-to-left languages
+                LayoutMirroring.enabled: false
+
+                Repeater {
+                    id: repeater
+                    model: ShellContainmentModel
+
+                    delegate: Delegate {
+                        viewPort: mainPage
+                        Layout.row: model.layoutRow
+                        Layout.column: model.layoutColumn
+                        Layout.preferredWidth: mainGrid.cellWidth
+                        Layout.maximumWidth: mainGrid.cellWidth
+                        Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignTop
+                    }
                 }
             }
         }
diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/shellcontainmentconfiguration/Delegate.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/shellcontainmentconfiguration/Delegate.qml
index 9da4bf0b40..6774088297 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/shellcontainmentconfiguration/Delegate.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/shellcontainmentconfiguration/Delegate.qml
@@ -20,8 +20,6 @@ QQC2.Control {
     property bool containsDrag
     property alias contentsLayout: contentsLayout
 
-    width: Math.min(Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 25, Math.floor(viewPort.width / Math.min(repeater.count, Math.floor(viewPort.width / (Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 12)))))
-
     contentItem: ColumnLayout {
         id: contentsLayout
         width: Math.min(parent.width, Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 15)
--
